items.title: UK Supreme Court rules Spain and France must pay damages in Prestige oil spill arbitration dispute
items.summary: The UK Supreme Court has unanimously ruled that Spain and France owe contractual damages to the London Steam-Ship Owners' Mutual Insurance Association for bypassing a London arbitration clause following the 2002 sinking of the tanker Prestige.

items.title: Pension schemes advised to target members born between April 1971 and 1973 ahead of NMPA rise
items.summary: Pension schemes are being told to plan communications this year for members facing a shrinking window to access pensions at 55.

items.title: British Coal Staff Superannuation Scheme appoints Brightwell
items.summary: Brightwell is set to take over administration for the 36,000-member British Coal Staff Superannuation Scheme from October 2027.

items.title: Chancellor John Healey questioned over pre-Budget bank tax surcharge leak
items.summary: Chancellor John Healey and a Treasury official have faced Treasury Committee questions following the pre-Budget leak of the bank tax surcharge.

items.title: Fujifilm UK pension scheme completes £46m buy-in with Royal London
items.summary: The Fujifilm UK Limited Pension and Life Assurance Scheme has secured a £46m bulk purchase annuity transaction with Royal London for 484 members.
